text:
incident-bot: PAGING: prefix-cache hit-rate dropped from ~92% to ~11% across eu-west-1 (alert threshold 40%). auto-escalation oncall -> sre-olivia.

sre-olivia: acked. looking at dashboards now. can someone grab the last 2 deploys in that region? :eyes:

prod-ops-maria: i see two deploys in the window: runtime v2.4.8 @ 11:12UTC and small config tweak to cache settings v2.4.8+hotfix @ 11:45UTC. both to eu-west-1 pool. linking deploy-bot logs.

deploy-bot: Deploy v2.4.8 started 2026-03-15T11:12:07Z, succeeded 11:12:55Z. Hotfix v2.4.8-hotfix started 11:45:03Z, succeeded 11:45:41Z.

oncall-ml: impact: increased tail latency observed for generation routes, customer error reports (CS ticket #5471) about 503s during 11:50-12:10UTC. embedding routes not affected.

customer-success-ian: CS: customer-prod-42 reported degraded throughput and intermittent 503s. they're on Dedicated in eu-west-1. said it started around 11:48.

eng-runtime-raj: hypothesis: the hotfix changed prefix eviction behavior for KV-cache reuse. suspect sticky eviction policy accidentally set to aggressive invalidation. looking for prefix_miss logs.

eng-runtime-raj: sharing quick grep output from edge host logs (redacted):
```
[11:47:58Z] prefix_lookup key="/org/42/pfx_abc" result=MISS
[11:48:00Z] prefix_lookup key="/org/42/pfx_abc" result=MISS
[11:48:01Z] prefix_lookup key="/org/42/pfx_abc" result=MISS
[11:48:02Z] kv_reuse: eligible=false reason=evicted_by_policy
[11:48:05Z] cache_client: fallback_to_model=fast-lm-1
```

oncall-ml: timeline so far: deploy hotfix 11:45 -> hit-rate collapse 11:47-11:50 -> customer reports 11:48-11:52. matches.

sre-olivia: can we quantify hit-rate by prefix histogram? oncall-ml, can you run metrics query: sum(prefix_hits) / sum(prefix_total) grouped by prefix over 10m?

oncall-ml: running now. query:
```
rate(prefix_hit_total{region="eu-west-1"}[5m])
/ rate(prefix_lookup_total{region="eu-west-1"}[5m])
```

oncall-ml: top affected prefixes show hit-rate ~3-8% post-11:45; pre-11:30 they were >90%.

prod-ops-maria: mitigation options: 1) roll back hotfix (fast but full config revert), 2) bump eviction threshold/TTL for prefixes (safer), 3) trigger cache-warmers for critical orgs. which do we want?

eng-runtime-raj: quick patch idea: temporarily set eviction_policy=least_recently_invalidated -> less aggressive and restart the cache worker only (no full runtime restart). Should be quick. I can patch and roll to a subset of nodes.

sre-olivia: do it as canary to 10% of pool first. monitor prefix-hit rates and 503s. assign owners: raj will patch, maria will coordinate rollout, olivia will monitor SLO dash and open rollbook.

eng-runtime-raj: patch posted to canary group at 11:58, rolling. patch snippet:
```
cache:
  eviction_policy: conservative
  prefix_ttl_seconds: 3600
```

prod-ops-maria: canary applied to 12 hosts (eu-west-1-canary).

oncall-ml: observing canary: prefix hit-rate on canary nodes improved from 6% -> 87% within 90s. overall region still low because only 10% traffic.

sre-olivia: good signal. approve wider rollout. maria please expand to 50% then 100% if stable.

prod-ops-maria: rolling to 50% now. ETA ~2m.

oncall-ml: after 50% rollout, region-wide hit-rate jumped to 65% and 503s dropped by ~70%. CS notified.

customer-success-ian: updated customer-prod-42. they're seeing improved throughput. keeping them in loop.

eng-runtime-raj: follow-up: need RCA notes: root cause seems to be a bad default in hotfix that flipped a boolean controlling KV reuse eligibility for prefix entries (allowed_reuse=false). unintentionally evicted warm prefixes. logs show explicit 'eligible=false' events.

sre-olivia: can someone capture a concise timeline and attach logs/traces for postmortem? i'll own the incident page. required artifacts: - Grafana hit-rate graphs (pre/during/post) - deploy diffs (hotfix) - cache worker config change history - raw logs for sample prefix (/org/42/pfx_abc) - customer CS thread.

eng-runtime-raj: pushing a PR to revert the config default in the hotfix and adding a unit test to prevent regression. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/2118

prod-ops-maria: full rollout completed 12:05UTC. region hit-rate stabilized ~91% by 12:07. closing active mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to S2 at 12:10UTC based on reduced customer impact and restored hit-rates.

sre-olivia: handoff: my shift ends in 40m. i'll collect artifacts and start the draft RCA. raj to add technical root-cause section, maria to add rollout/microdeploy notes, oncall-ml to attach metrics queries and raw outputs. customer-success-ian to paste CS transcript. i will publish initial RCA draft in #postmortems when ready.

oncall-ml: attaching quick metric dumps (pasted):
```
prefix_hit_rate_pre: 0.92 (11:00-11:40)
prefix_hit_rate_during: 0.07 (11:45-11:55)
prefix_hit_rate_post: 0.91 (12:00-12:10)
```

customer-success-ian: pasted CS snippet: "we saw a spike of 503s, throttled requests dropped after you rolled the patch, thanks for fast response."

eng-runtime-raj: leaving a note for RCA: ACTIONS -> add guard in config parsing to reject unknown defaults, unit test for eviction flag, and add a canary monitor to alert if prefix hit-rate drops >20% within 5m of deploy.

sre-olivia: logging task assignments into incident tracker. will schedule a 1hr post-incident review tomorrow. thanks all. :heart:

prod-ops-maria: closing channel for active response. if anything reoccurs reopen.

sre-olivia: handoff to night oncall: @oncall-ml will monitor till 20:00UTC then pass to night-sre.

oncall-ml: ack. I'll keep watch and post any regressions.

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 12:20UTC and archived.

sre-olivia: final note for RCA: probable root cause = hotfix accidentally set allowed_reuse=false for prefix entries; mitigation = changed eviction_policy to conservative and reverted default; long-term fix = config validation + deploy canary monitor.
